_comment: Surround locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, best to worst); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Jwè Surround sou yon {width}x{height} gwaf. 
Ou se jwè {player_id}. Deplasman valab: '[up]' '[down]' '[left]' '[right]' oswa w/s/a/d. 
Objektif: siviv tout moun. Tras se letal; kou anba wal yo touye; kolizyon tèt-an-tèt touye de moun.

board.after_moves: Komisyon Konsèy la apre mouvman similtane: {board}

outcome.survived_win: Jwè {player_id} siviv; tout lòt moun te fè aksidan.
outcome.all_crashed: Tout jwè yo te tonbe an menm tan.
outcome.outlived: Jwè a te viv pi lontan pase tout lòt moun.
outcome.turn_limit: Limit vire rive - pi long siviv genyen.
outcome.ranking: {reason} Klasman final gwoup yo (pi bon→pi mal): {groups}
